verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible left-to-right banner flow with logo, can, then headline, body and CTA. Still, the NEW FLAVOR badge is tiny and floats alone in the big circle, the body line sits tight on the CTA, the CTA crowds the bottom edge, and the right-hand text block is almost aligned rather than truly aligned. B is clearly worse: the headline breaks into an awkward 'Chase the / Light' stack that crowds the top edge, the body copy is squeezed into a ragged five-line column of a word or two per line, the logo has fallen to the bottom under the circle so the brand reads last, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge.
